title: Core Abstractions & Utilities
summary: This module provides the foundational interfaces, base classes, and essential utilities that underpin the entire LangChain ecosystem, enabling core functionalities, API management, security, and performance enhancements.

nodes.label: Core Interfaces & Runnables
nodes.title: Foundational Interfaces
nodes.description: Defines core abstract base classes for serializable objects, composable runnables, language models, prompts, parsers, tools, retrievers, document loaders, vector stores, and memory systems.

nodes.label: API & Security Utilities
nodes.title: API Lifecycle & Security
nodes.description: Provides utilities for managing API lifecycle (beta/deprecation warnings) and robust security features like Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) protection for URL validation and HTTP clients.

nodes.label: General Helper Utilities
nodes.title: General-Purpose Helpers
nodes.description: Offers a collection of general utilities including system info, data stream manipulation, HTML parsing, Pydantic helpers, serialization/deserialization, and version consistency checks.

nodes.label: Caching & Chat History
nodes.title: Performance & State Management
nodes.description: Provides in-memory implementations for caching LLM responses and storing chat message history, enabling efficient retrieval and state management for conversational AI applications.

groups.label: Core Abstractions
groups.title: Fundamental Building Blocks
groups.description: The essential interfaces and base classes that define the structure and behavior of all LangChain components.

groups.label: System & General Utilities
groups.title: Cross-Cutting Support Services
groups.description: Modules providing underlying infrastructure, security, API management, and general-purpose helper functions for the entire framework.

groups.label: Runtime State & Performance
groups.title: Optimizing Execution & State
groups.description: Components focused on enhancing application performance and managing conversational state through caching and message history mechanisms.
